titulo: Vitachy Sink Organiser, Black, 4 in 1 Kitchen Dispenser, Dishwasher and Hands Dispenser, Scouring Pad and Sponge Holder - Countertop Accessory Set, Space Saving
bullets: 4 IN 1 ORGANIZATION Transform your sink with this complete set. Integrates a pressure washer soap dispenser (450 ml, one hand), a dispenser with hand soap pump (350 ml), a ventilated sponge for the sponge and a rear holder for drying the tea towel. Everything you need in one place.

High-quality materials: made to last. Combines a solid HIPS (High Impact) body with a 304 stainless steel rod that can withstand moisture without rusting. The base features a non-slip rubber (TPR) that attaches the organizer to the countertop so it does not move when in use.

Save & Efficiency The pressure system of the kitchen dispenser delivers the exact dosage of detergent directly onto the scouring pad. This allows one-handed scrubbing, prevents soap wastage and keeps the washing area cleaner and faster.

Cleanliness without force: designed for absolute hygiene. The organiser disassembles completely with your hands to facilitate washing under the tap and prevent the accumulation of dirty water and bacteria on the bottom of the scouring pad.

COMPACT FOR ANY WORKSPACE Measuring 18 x 10.5 x 14.5 cm, this accessory set optimizes space at the highest level. Ideal for small kitchens or low rim sinks, eliminating the visual sound of loose bottles.
descripcion_html: Vitachy The ultimate accessory set for your worktop. <p>Is your sink always surrounded by plastic bottles, damp sponges and messy cloths? The Vitachy sink organizer puts an end to visual chaos by combining all the cleaning tools in one sleek and durable design. </p><p>Designed for modern kitchens looking for functionality, this 4-in-1 dispenser optimizes every inch of your countertop, providing you with a dedicated space to scrub dishes and wash your hands comfortably. </p>High-quality composition and materials. <p>Unlike basic organisers, the Vitachy model is built with a selection of 5 specific materials to ensure its durability in humid environments (HIPS+PS+TPR+PP+304SS): </p><ul><li>DURABLE BODY (HIPS): The main structure is made of high impact polystyrene, a rigid material that can withstand impact and daily use without deformation. </li><li>Stainless Steel (304SS) The towel rack is made of 304 grade stainless steel, which ensures that no rust or corrosion occurs despite contact with wet rags. </li><li>NON-SLIP BASE (TPR):With thermoplastic rubber at the bottom to ensure a firm grip on the wet countertop and prevent the dispenser from "dancing" when you press to get soap out. </li><li>Durable Mechanism (PP) The internal components of the pump are made of polypropylene, resistant to chemical corrosion that causes long-term concentrated soaps. </li><li>Translucent Visor (PS): The front window made of polystyrene allows you to see the remaining amount of soap. </li></ul>Outstanding functionality: <ul><li>Double washing function: 450ml tank for dishwasher (pressure with sponge) and 350ml for hand soap (gentle pump). </li><li>HYGIENIC SCRUBBER - Ventilated compartment prevents water accumulation in the sponge. </li><li>SPACE SAVING Compact design frees up sink space and organizes all your utensils. </li></ul><p>Technical data: </p><ul><li>Measures 18 cm length by 10.5 cm width by 14.5 cm height </li><li>Colour: matte black and transparent. </li><li>Care: Fully dismountable and washable under running water. </li></ul><p>Give your kitchen the touch of order, quality and elegance you need with Vitachy. </p>
